# IMPERIA COLD WAR — COMECON 1970 (start, clock, members, calendar, Chair, Secretary).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_CMEA_generator/build.py (do not edit by hand).

# Any scope. Calendar from the start epoch (1 Jan 1970, 365-day years): temp cwcm_t_y (years since 1970), cwcm_t_doy (0 = 1 Jan), cwcm_t_ystart (num_days of this 1 January).
COLDWAR_CMEA_calendar_now = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_d = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_d = global.cwcm_epoch }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_d min = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_doy = cwcm_t_d }
	modulo_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_doy value = 365 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = cwcm_t_d }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = cwcm_t_doy }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_y = 365 }
	round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_y
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ystart = cwcm_t_y }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ystart = 365 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ystart = global.cwcm_epoch }
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_next = num_days of the next 1 January (always in the future).
COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jan1 = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_calendar_now = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = cwcm_t_ystart }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 0 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = 365 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_next = num_days of the next 1 July.
COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_calendar_now = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = cwcm_t_ystart }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = 181 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 181 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = 365 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_next = num_days of the next 1 June (the Session of the Council).

}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_next = num_days of the next 1 January or 1 July.
COLDWAR_CMEA_next_half_year = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_calendar_now = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 181 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = cwcm_t_ystart }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = 181 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = cwcm_t_ystart }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_next = 365 }
	}
}

	subtract_from_variable = { global.cwcm_epoch = cwcm_t_e }
}

# Country scope. Vote, order of the Chair, ratification period, developing status.
COLDWAR_CMEA_set_country_data = {
	# one country, one vote (Charter 1959)
	set_variable = { cwcm_weight = 1 }
	# order of the Chair (Russian alphabetical order); later members after them
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ALB }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = BUL }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = HUN }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = VIE }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = DDR }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = CUB }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = MON }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = POL }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ROM }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SOV }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = CZE }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 11 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SER }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = 12 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwcm_rank = THIS.id }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_rank = 100 }
	}
	# ratification period of a passive member
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SOV }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 150 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = DDR }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 120 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = CZE }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 120 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = POL }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 150 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = HUN }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 150 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = BUL }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 120 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ROM }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 240 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = MON }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = CUB }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 240 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = VIE }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 240 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwcm_ratdays = 180 }
	}
	# developing members (pay half for programmes for five years after their admission)
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { original_tag = MON original_tag = CUB original_tag = VIE original_tag = LAO original_tag = AFG original_tag = ETH original_tag = MOZ original_tag = AGL original_tag = NIC original_tag = SYE } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_developing
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_developing
	}
}

# Country scope. Country with a status at the Council (read by the monthly check).
COLDWAR_CMEA_watch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_watch value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwcm_watch = THIS }
	}
}

# Country scope. The membership spirit.
COLDWAR_CMEA_add_member_idea = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_member } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_member }
}

# Country scope. Full membership (start members and every admission).
COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member ([THIS.GetName])"
	set_variable = { cwcm_status = 5 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_associate } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_associate }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_observer } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_observer }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_add_member_idea = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_members value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwcm_members = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_set_country_data = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_watch = yes
	set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_community } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_community }
	}
	# passive members take part in every recommendation in force; players join one by one ("Join")
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_join_all_recommendations = yes
	}
	# passive members have fixed plan sectors
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ai_sectors = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_country = yes
}

# Country scope. Leaves the Council (six months after the notice, or the loss of the country). Rejoin after three years.
COLDWAR_CMEA_leave_member = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_CMEA_leave_member ([THIS.GetName])"
	set_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_members = THIS }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_member } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_member }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_presidency } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_presidency }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_commission_president } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_commission_president }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_community } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_community } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_plan } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_plan } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_shared_aid } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_shared_aid } }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_clear_participation = yes
	set_variable = { cwcm_sp1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_sp2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_esp1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_esp2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_quota = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_wk_pay = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_wk_recv = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_net = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_aidcap = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_leaving
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_rejoin_cooldown days = 1095 value = 1 }
	# the offices pass on, except when the whole Council dissolves (A8)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_interim_chair = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_com = THIS.id }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_vacate_secretary = yes
	}
	# open accounts: a borrower repays the rest of its credit at once (to the members by GDP share), programmes abroad it requested end, its candidacy is withdrawn
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target = THIS.id } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = global.cwcm_l1_end }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = global.num_days }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_rest min = 0 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = 7 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = global.cwcm_l1_weekly }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_rest }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
			if = { limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_lg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_rest }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_weekly = 0 }
		clear_array = global.cwcm_l1_lenders
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target = THIS.id } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = global.cwcm_l2_end }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = global.num_days }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_rest min = 0 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = 7 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_rest = global.cwcm_l2_weekly }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_rest }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_lg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
			if = { limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_lg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_rest }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_weekly = 0 }
		clear_array = global.cwcm_l2_lenders
	}
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_l1_lenders = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_l2_lenders = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_by = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_h1_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_by = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_h2_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_by = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_h3_end = yes
	}
	# programmes abroad of the others: the leaver no longer pays its share
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_h1_part = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_h2_part = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_h3_part = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_nominees = THIS }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_drop_files_of = yes
	# a ratification state of an earlier file must not carry over to a later membership
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_5 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_6 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 0 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_recount = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_evaluate = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_update_shared_capacity = yes
	# the last missing vote may have left with it
	COLDWAR_CMEA_check_all_voted = yes
}

# Country scope (a member that leaves or vanished). Its own IIB credit request and the files about it close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_drop_files_of = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase > 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target = THIS.id }
				AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_by = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_item = 24 } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Co-operation agreement in force (partner of the Council).
COLDWAR_CMEA_become_associate = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_status = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_observer } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_observer }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_associate } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_associate }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_set_country_data = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_watch = yes
	# partners are refreshed with the external Council modifier
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_ext value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ext = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_external_country = yes
}

# Country scope. Observer at the Council.
COLDWAR_CMEA_become_observer = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_associate = yes } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_status = 6 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_observer } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_observer }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_set_country_data = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_watch = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts members and seated players (one vote each).
COLDWAR_CMEA_recount = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_n_members = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_w_total = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_n_players = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_n_passive = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_w_players = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_n_members = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_w_total = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_n_players = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_w_players = 1 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_n_passive = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Start of the 1970 scenario (on_startup) or bootstrap of an older save.
COLDWAR_CMEA_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_initialized } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_CMEA_initialize (Council for Mutual Economic Assistance)"
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_initialized
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.cwcm_epoch } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_epoch = global.num_days }
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ticket = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_name = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_com = 0 }
		# the eight members of 1970, Albania (inactive since 1961), Yugoslavia (agreement 1964), the observers
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV } SOV = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = POL } POL = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CZE } CZE = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = HUN } HUN = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ROM } ROM = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = BUL } BUL = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR } DDR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = MON } MON = { COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwcm_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ALB } ALB = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 7 } COLDWAR_CMEA_set_country_data = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_watch = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SER } SER = { COLDWAR_CMEA_become_associate = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CUB } CUB = { COLDWAR_CMEA_become_observer = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = VIE } VIE = { COLDWAR_CMEA_become_observer = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NKO } NKO = { COLDWAR_CMEA_become_observer = yes } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_recount = yes
		# prices: the Bucharest formula, fixed for the five-year plan
		COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_init = yes
		# plan coordination: the register for 1971-75 is open until 31 December 1970
		COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_init = yes
		# offices: a Chair ballot and the Secretary candidacy open at once; the first player in the order acts as Chair until then
		COLDWAR_CMEA_interim_chair = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_open_ballot = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_open_secretary = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Older 1970 saves start the system at the first monthly tick.
COLDWAR_CMEA_bootstrap = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_initialized }
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_bootstrap_epoch = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_initialize = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. temp cwcm_t_pr: place in the order of succession after the outgoing Chair (temp cwcm_t_outrank).
COLDWAR_CMEA_chair_priority = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pr = cwcm_rank }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rank > cwcm_t_outrank } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pr = 1000 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_outrank: rank of the current Chair (0 without one).
COLDWAR_CMEA_outgoing_rank = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_outrank = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_pres = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwcm_pres = { set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_outrank = cwcm_rank } }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_chair: the new Chair (0 = none).
COLDWAR_CMEA_set_chair = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_pres = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwcm_pres = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_presidency } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_presidency } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = cwcm_t_chair }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_away_pres = 0 }
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_chair_free_used
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_pres_forward_used
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_pres = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_presidency }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. The next player member in the order of succession takes the Chair until the ballot (start, a Chair that left or stayed away).
COLDWAR_CMEA_interim_chair = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_outgoing_rank = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 99999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no
					NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_pres } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_chair_priority = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_pr < cwcm_t_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_t_pr }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = THIS.id }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_pres = { exists = yes is_ai = no COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = global.cwcm_pres }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_set_chair = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_pres = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.10 } } }
	}
}

# Any scope. The annual ballot for the Chair: every player member stands, every player member casts one sealed vote, 15 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_open_ballot = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jan1 = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_pres_next = cwcm_t_next }
	clear_array = global.cwcm_bcands
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				add_to_array = { global.cwcm_bcands = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_bcands^num > 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_item = 150 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 12 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_stage = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_since = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_due = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_due = 15 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_len = 15 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no }  country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.20 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_bcands^num > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = global.cwcm_bcands^0 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_set_chair = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_interim_chair = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). temp cwcm_t_v: the candidate. The vote is sealed.
COLDWAR_CMEA_cast_ballot = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_bvote = cwcm_t_v }
	set_variable = { cwcm_bvote_issue = global.cwcm_s9_issue }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Counts the ballot: most votes win; a tie goes to the next in the order after the outgoing Chair; without votes the next in the order takes the Chair.
COLDWAR_CMEA_close_ballot = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_outgoing_rank = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_most = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 99999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_bcands
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cnt = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_bvote_issue = global.cwcm_s9_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_bvote = PREV.id } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cnt = 1 } }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_ballot_votes = cwcm_t_cnt }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_chair_priority = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cnt > cwcm_t_most } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_most = cwcm_t_cnt }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_t_pr }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = THIS.id }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cnt = cwcm_t_most }
					check_variable = { cwcm_t_pr < cwcm_t_best } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = cwcm_t_pr }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_chair = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_last_ballot = cwcm_t_most }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_set_chair = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_pres }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev21_target = global.cwcm_pres } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.21 } }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_term: four years.
COLDWAR_CMEA_secretary_term = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_term = 1460 }
}

# Any scope. A new term of the Secretary: every player member may stand for 30 days (50 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_open_secretary = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_com_next = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cwcm_nominees
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_item = 151 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 9 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_by = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = 30 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 30 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no }  country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.11 } }
	}
}

# Any scope. The Secretary leaves office; the Chair runs the Secretariat ad interim and a candidacy opens.
COLDWAR_CMEA_vacate_secretary = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_com > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_com = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwcm_com = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_commission_president } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_commission_president } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_com = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_away_com = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase > 0 } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_open_secretary = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_sec: the elected Secretary takes office for four years.
COLDWAR_CMEA_appoint_secretary = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_com > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_com = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwcm_com = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_commission_president } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_commission_president } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_com = cwcm_t_sec }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_away_com = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_com > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_com = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_CMEA_commission_president }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_secretary_term = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_com_next = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_com_next = cwcm_t_term }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_com }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev13_target = global.cwcm_com } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.13 } }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (player member). Stands for Secretary of the Council.
COLDWAR_CMEA_stand_secretary = {
	add_political_power = -50
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_nominees value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwcm_nominees = THIS }
	}
	# a lone candidate during an open candidacy is elected after 14 days unless another player stands
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_stage = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_nominees^num = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = 14 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 14 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. End of the candidacy: two or more candidates go to the election, one is elected, none keeps the candidacy open.
COLDWAR_CMEA_close_candidacy = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_nominees^num > 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 11 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_stage = 3 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = 30 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 30 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no }  country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.22 } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_nominees^num = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sec = global.cwcm_nominees^0 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_appoint_secretary = yes
	}
	else = {
		# nobody stood: the candidacy stays open, the Chair runs the Secretariat
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_stage = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = 7 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). temp cwcm_t_v: the candidate (0 = abstain); can be changed until the election closes.
COLDWAR_CMEA_cast_secretary_vote = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_svote = cwcm_t_v }
	set_variable = { cwcm_svote_issue = global.cwcm_s10_issue }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Counts the election: most votes win, a tie goes to the earlier candidacy.
COLDWAR_CMEA_close_secretary_vote = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_most = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sec = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_nominees
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cnt = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no check_variable = { cwcm_svote_issue = global.cwcm_s10_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_svote = PREV.id } } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_cnt = 1 } }
			}
			set_variable = { cwcm_election_votes = cwcm_t_cnt }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_cnt > cwcm_t_most } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_most = cwcm_t_cnt }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sec = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_sec > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_appoint_secretary = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_open_secretary = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly: ballot and election deadlines, office holders who stay away.
COLDWAR_CMEA_offices_tick = {
	# ballot and election deadlines
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 12 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s9_due } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_close_ballot = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 9 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s10_due } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_close_candidacy = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 11 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s10_due } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_close_secretary_vote = yes
	}
	# office holders governed by the AI for 90 days lose the office (absent players keep it until then)
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_pres = { exists = yes is_ai = yes } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_away_pres = 7 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_away_pres = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_away_pres < 90 } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_interim_chair = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_com > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_com = { exists = yes is_ai = yes } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_away_com = 7 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_away_com = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_away_com < 90 } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_vacate_secretary = yes
	}
	# a Council without a Chair takes the first player who appears
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = 0 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_any_player_member = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_interim_chair = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (member). Rebuilds the variables of the Council modifier.
COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_country = {
	# council values: decisions for all members, recommendations the member takes part in, major projects, returns of programmes abroad
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_HM = global.cwcm_c_HM }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_HM = cwcm_m_HM }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_HM = global.cwcm_aidret_HM }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_HM min = -0.1 max = 0.35 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_ZS = global.cwcm_c_ZS }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ZS = cwcm_m_ZS }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ZS = global.cwcm_aidret_ZS }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_ZS min = -0.06 max = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_AS = global.cwcm_c_AS }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_AS = cwcm_m_AS }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_AS = global.cwcm_aidret_AS }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_AS min = -0.1 max = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_AP = global.cwcm_c_AP }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_AP = cwcm_m_AP }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_AP = global.cwcm_aidret_AP }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_AP min = -0.05 max = 0.25 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_ZP = global.cwcm_c_ZP }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ZP = cwcm_m_ZP }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ZP = global.cwcm_aidret_ZP }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_ZP min = -0.05 max = 0.15 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_PW = global.cwcm_c_PW }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_PW = cwcm_m_PW }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_PW = global.cwcm_aidret_PW }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_PW min = 0 max = 0.03 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_FO = global.cwcm_c_FO }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_FO = cwcm_m_FO }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_FO = global.cwcm_aidret_FO }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_FO min = -0.03 max = 0.12 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_ZI = global.cwcm_c_ZI }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ZI = cwcm_m_ZI }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ZI = global.cwcm_aidret_ZI }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_ZI min = -1 max = 0.5 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_ST = global.cwcm_c_ST }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ST = cwcm_m_ST }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_ST = global.cwcm_aidret_ST }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_ST min = -0.08 max = 0.08 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_PP = global.cwcm_c_PP }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_PP = cwcm_m_PP }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_PP = global.cwcm_aidret_PP }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_PP min = -0.2 max = 0.05 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_BK = global.cwcm_c_BK }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_BK = cwcm_m_BK }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_BK = global.cwcm_aidret_BK }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_BK min = -0.06 max = 0.15 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_SK = global.cwcm_c_SK }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_SK = cwcm_m_SK }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_SK = global.cwcm_aidret_SK }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_SK min = -0.06 max = 0.12 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_KG = global.cwcm_c_KG }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_KG = cwcm_m_KG }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_KG = global.cwcm_aidret_KG }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_KG min = -0.04 max = 0.05 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_WE = global.cwcm_c_WE }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_WE = cwcm_m_WE }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_WE = global.cwcm_aidret_WE }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_WE min = 0 max = 0.3 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_OR = global.cwcm_c_OR }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_OR = cwcm_m_OR }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_OR = global.cwcm_aidret_OR }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_OR min = 0 max = 0.3 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_IB = global.cwcm_c_IB }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_IB = cwcm_m_IB }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_IB = global.cwcm_aidret_IB }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_IB min = 0 max = 0.25 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_AK = global.cwcm_c_AK }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_AK = cwcm_m_AK }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_AK = global.cwcm_aidret_AK }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_workers_host }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_AK = cwcm_aidw_AK }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_AK min = 0 max = 0.04 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_IND = global.cwcm_c_IND }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_IND = cwcm_m_IND }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_IND = global.cwcm_aidret_IND }
	# importers lose factory output when the suppliers cut their deliveries (-1 % for every 10 %)
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_IND = global.cwcm_quota_ind }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_IND min = 0 max = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_MIL = global.cwcm_c_MIL }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_MIL = cwcm_m_MIL }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_MIL = global.cwcm_aidret_MIL }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_MIL min = 0 max = 0.06 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_c_REX = global.cwcm_c_REX }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_REX = cwcm_m_REX }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_c_REX = global.cwcm_aidret_REX }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_c_REX min = -0.1 max = 0.15 }
	# shared assistance capacity
	set_variable = { cwcm_aidcap = global.cwcm_aidcap_malus }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_aidcap < 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_shared_aid } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_shared_aid } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_shared_aid } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_shared_aid } }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_cw_dirty
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Refreshes every member and every partner with an external Council modifier.
COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_country = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_external = yes
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_cw_dirty
}

# Any scope. Recurring business without an end date: the June Session, the Chair ballot, the Secretary, prices, plan periods.
COLDWAR_CMEA_calendar_tick = {
	# the Session of the Council sits in June
	COLDWAR_CMEA_calendar_now = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy > 150 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_doy < 181 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session } }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session }
			clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jun1 = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_session_next = cwcm_t_next }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_pres_next } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase > 0 } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_open_ballot = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_com_next > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_com_next } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase > 0 } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_open_secretary = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_px_next } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_prices_year = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_plan_close } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_period_start = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The weekly clock reads only the open files (at most ten), the running programmes, the offices and the calendar; it never loops over the world.
COLDWAR_CMEA_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_calendar_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_offices_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_slots_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_floor_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_loans_tick = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_recount = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Monthly: members, settlement, programmes abroad, modifiers.
COLDWAR_CMEA_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_check_members = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_check_leavers = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. A member that no longer exists leaves the array (annexation, dissolution); its offices, loan and programmes close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_check_members = {
	clear_temp_array = cwcm_t_dead
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } }
			add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_dead = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_dead^num > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwcm_t_dead
			remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_members = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_nominees = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_bcands = THIS }
			set_variable = { cwcm_status = 0 }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_h1_part = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_h2_part = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_h3_part = THIS }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_drop_files_of = yes
		}
		# offices and accounts that pointed at a vanished member
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_pres = { exists = yes } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = 0 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_interim_chair = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_com > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_com = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_vacate_secretary = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_l1_target = { exists = yes } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_target = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l1_weekly = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_l2_target = { exists = yes } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_target = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_l2_weekly = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_by > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_h1_by = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_h1_end = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_by > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_h2_by = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_h2_end = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_by > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_h3_by = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_h3_end = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_recount = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. The admission takes effect on 1 July: full member; developing countries pay half for programmes for five years; IIB capital.
COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [THIS.GetName]: COLDWAR_CMEA admission"
	COLDWAR_CMEA_join_member = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_developing }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_transition days = 1825 value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_iib }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_iib_capital = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_new = THIS.id }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev9_target = cwcm_t_new } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.9 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_recount = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_count = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_plan_evaluate = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
}

# Any scope. Monthly: a member whose notice has run six months leaves the Council (stability -3%, the members think worse of it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_check_leavers = {
	clear_temp_array = cwcm_t_leavers
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_leaving
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_leave_due } } }
				add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_leavers = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwcm_t_leavers
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_leaving
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_left } }
		}
		add_stability = -0.03
		COLDWAR_CMEA_leave_member = yes
	}
}
